sentences.text: For this UCB, the in-force rule says there is no capitalisation of penal charges, so penal interest may not be compounded at all.
The earlier RBI guidance also said there shall be no capitalisation of penal charges and that such charges shall not be levied in the form of penal interest added to the rate of interest.
The evidence does not support the assumption that RBI now allows penal interest to be capitalised for this bank.

missing.slot: support for RBI now allowing capitalisation of penal interest
missing.searched: in-force RBI or UCB rule permitting capitalisation or compounding frequency for penal interest
any evidence stating how often penal interest may be compounded
